//: The product this checkout builds: its name, the version the system reports, and the release notes it ships.
Renumbering the release is changing "version" here and adding its entry at the top of the release notes (a test checks they agree).

"releaseNotes" names the notes file (the format of docs/APP-STORE.md "Update logs", without rebuild). webOS Phoenix 2.0 (phoenix-ember-glass-ui, which merges this repository) names its own file here, so this repository's release-notes.json merges into it unchanged.

runtime/rootfs.json "product" puts both on the device, at /usr/share/phoenix/product.json and /usr/share/phoenix/release-notes.json: phoenix-sim, tools/serve-rootfs.py and tools/install-rootfs.py (the image) read it. tools/release-notes-doc.py writes docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md from the notes.
name: webOS Phoenix
